title: [.green-span] Lendflow Roundup | August [.green-span]
summary: This month at Lendflow, we’re focused on building a stronger foundation for the future of lending. We’re introducing API improvements designed to make integrations easier, support more complex workflows, and enable the next generation of embedded and AI-powered lending experiences, alongside Dynamic Documents for more streamlined and consistent document collection.
body_markdown:
We’re also exploring some of the trends shaping the industry, including how financial health data can create a more complete view of borrowers and what AI4 2026 revealed about the rapidly evolving role of AI in lending. Read on for the latest product updates, insights, and ideas from Lendflow.


‍


###### UPDATES


### What We're Working On


### [Customize Document Requirements with Dynamic Docs](https://www.lendflow.com/post/customize-document-requirements-with-dynamic-docs)


Dynamic Documents make it easier to standardize document requirements by grouping related documents together and automatically adding them to new deals through Workflow Builder templates.


[Learn More about Dynamic Docs>](https://www.lendflow.com/post/customize-document-requirements-with-dynamic-docs)
